title: Investigating the Mu:Kappa Opioid Receptor Imbalance in Alcohol Use Disorder
official: Investigating the Mu:Kappa Opioid Receptor Imbalance in Alcohol Use Disorder
summary: The primary objective of this multimodal positron emission tomography (PET) study is to use PET brain imaging to measure both MOR (Mu-Opioid receptors) and KOR (kappa-opioid receptors) in participants with alcohol use disorder (AUD) and to quantify the relationships between MOR and KOR, separately and jointly, to key clinical outcomes (e.g., craving, mood, withdrawal, time to lapse) during a quit attempt.
